title: OpenAI Seeks Purchase of Security Startup Trail of Bits
summary:
The organization behind the GPT models is in preliminary talks to acquire a firm specializing in cryptocurrency security, reporting from The Information indicates. OpenAI is currently in early discussions to purchase the security startup Trail of Bits as it expands its focus on cybersecurity infrastructure.

Cybersecurity is projected to become a large area of business for leading AI developers, including OpenAI and Anthropic. Industry observers note that securing AI models and their deployments will be a central priority for the sector as it scales commercial operations.
